messages.subject: Reproducibility of featureCounts with -T > 1
parts:
The results are not identical if I run featureCounts on the same bam file twice, e.g.:

subread-1.5.0-p2-Linux-x86_64/bin/featureCounts -a refFlat.mm9.140822.gtf -o Aligned.zip.stream.counts.txt -F GTF -g transcript_id -O -p Aligned.zip.stream.sorted.bam

subread/subread-1.5.0-p2-Linux-x86_64/bin/featureCounts -a /refFlat.mm9.140822.gtf -o Aligned.zip.stream.counts.2.txt -F GTF -g transcript_id -O -p Aligned.zip.stream.sorted.bam

Here is a log10-log10 scatter plot of the count output from the 2 commands:


Is it possible to ensure that the output is identical for multiple run on the same input file?
